General Sir John Kotelawala National
Defence University
BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :-

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  General  Sir  John
Kotelawala National Defence University Act, No.    of 2021,
and the provisions of this Act, shall come into operation on
such date as the Minister may appoint by Order published in
the Gazette (hereinafter referred to as the “appointed date”).
PART I
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE GENERAL SIR JOHN KOTELAWALA NATIONAL
DEFENCE UNIVERSITY

2.
(1)  Notwithstanding 
the  provisions  of 
the
Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, there shall be established a
University called “the General Sir John Kotelawala National
Defence  University’’(hereinafter  referred  to  as  “the
University”).
(2)  The  University  shall  be  a  body  corporate  with
perpetual succession and a common seal, and by the name
assigned to it by subsection (1), may sue and be sued, in all
courts.
